name: nonce0-api
description: x402-gated scan API. The only directory in this repo with a node_modules.
comment: Deliberately empty until build step 10. x402 middleware and @hashgraph/sdk
install HERE and only here. This directory is a SIBLING of ../src, so Node's
upward module resolution can never reach backend/node_modules from a file
that ships inside the npm tarball. That is what makes the scanner's
zero-dependency claim structural instead of a promise.
